description: Plan moving three hard-coded settings (database URL, SMTP host and password, debug flag) into environment variables read by one app/settings.py: every hard-coded place is covered, the settings module comes before its users, and the password never stays in code.

criteria: The plan creates app/settings.py reading DATABASE_URL, SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PASSWORD and DEBUG from the environment first, then switches app/db.py, app/mailer.py and app/main.py to it, removes the hard-coded password, and documents the variables in .env.example.
